x.description: Input array giving the base value. Must have floating or complex type.

y.description: Input array giving the exponent value. Must have integer, floating, or complex type. Its dtype will be cast to that of ``x.dtype`` if necessary. If neither ``x`` nor ``y`` is a scalar, then ``x`` and ``y`` must have the same number of dimensions and be broadcast-compatible.
constraints: If neither `x` nor `y` is a scalar, then `x` and `y` must have the same number of dimensions and be broadcast-compatible.
y must be one of x.dtype
If `y` is not provided, it defaults to 1 for each dimension.

output.description: An array of the same dtype as ``x`` containing the elementwise power.

constraints: The argument dtypes must match, and will be converted if necessary.
